name: update_contact
description: Verify Marc Henry's contact record is set as primary.

validation_config.query: SELECT is_primary FROM contact WHERE contact_id = 10 AND portal_user_id = 20;

name: update_case
description: Verify Case CS-0000181 priority, state, and escalation status.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 181 AND priority = 'critical' AND state = 'in_progress' AND escalation = 1 AND escalation_reason = 'vip';

name: link_new_case_sla
description: Verify the Critical Resolution SLA is linked to Case CS-0000181 and is in progress.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_sla WHERE case_id = 181 AND sla_def_id = 6 AND stage = 'in_progress';

name: assign_case_to_user
description: Verify Case CS-0000181 is assigned to Escalation Management (ID 18) and Curtis Mccoy (ID 177).

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 181 AND assignment_group_id = 18 AND assigned_to = 177;

name: update_knowledge
description: Verify KB-0000103 is retired and visibility is set to internal.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge WHERE knowledge_id = 103 AND state = 'retired' AND visibility = 'internal';
